Singlet intertwiners identify R tensor R* within each orthogonal rest multiplicity. Partial trace of any singlet cross matrix over rest is the scalar identity on R times the multiplicity inner product. No unique singlet assumption.

It commutes local SU4 matter action because each local traceless colour matrix embeds in su(M); neutral action commutes separately. Then all Phi/Haar covariant derivatives commute P_S; fullE=-i transverse derivative plus linear collective rho also commutes P_S.
